sources.name: RadarMap public static files
sources.notes: Useful for UX/data-shape analysis. Do not ship copied assets/data without permission. Current prepare-data.mjs still reads region and preferred place names from this reference; replace that dependency before production.

sources.name: geoBoundaries RUS ADM1/ADM2
sources.license: ODbL 1.0 for RUS files per metadata; geoBoundaries site also describes CC BY 4.0 generally
sources.notes: ADM1 has 83 objects, not current 89-subject official list. Needs normalization.

sources.name: HydroSHEDS HydroRIVERS v1.0
sources.license: HydroSHEDS free for non-commercial and commercial use; citation/terms required
sources.notes: scripts/prepare-hydrorivers.mjs extracts Russia-map river segments from Europe/Middle East, Siberia, and Asia archives. The app publishes grouped major/detail GeoJSON for lazy loading.

sources.name: Natural Earth Admin 1 and Populated Places
sources.notes: Great low-zoom/global context. supplemental_regions_admin1.geojson extracts Crimea, Sevastopol, Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia, and Kherson admin-1 features for the prototype. Lakes, rivers, roads, railways, urban areas, terrain regions, and glaciated areas are filtered against the app region polygons before publishing.

sources.name: RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017
sources.notes: Used for overview forest/taiga, tundra, and flooded/wetland-like biome polygons in public/data/land-cover.json. This is biome/ecoregion coverage, not parcel-level forest or marsh inventory.

sources.name: Geofabrik OpenStreetMap Russia extracts
sources.notes: Use subregion extracts or osmium pipeline. Full Russia PBF is multi-GB.

sources.name: GeoNames RU dump
sources.notes: Full RU dump: 412372 features; populated places: 203217; compact extracted seed: 2080 rows.

sources.name: GeoNames UA dump, filtered supplemental territories
sources.notes: Only populated places with admin1 codes 05, 08, 11, 14, 20, and 26 are added to public/data/places.json.

sources.name: Росстат ОКТМО
sources.notes: 186604 CSV rows. No geometry. Use for canonical municipal hierarchy and names.

sources.name: ФИАС/ГАР
sources.license: official government data; verify before redistribution
sources.notes: Not downloaded: connection to fias.nalog.ru timed out from current environment.
